This is the actual 'room creation works again' outcome (Tron-verifiable) — distinct from the delete-protection arc (ddc37f95). Owner = expert (fixed) + tester (4 Test units) + architect (signed).
model.intention: An absent members field means 'unchanged', never 'drop all' — so creating a room can never be bricked by a false partial-write positive.
